Container.Name: chainlink-server
Container.Overview: ChainLink Server: FastAPI service and WebUI for a self-hosted disc golf catalog. Create chainlink_net first. PostgreSQL and the existing release schema must be ready before API use. Set DATABASE_URL locally; see unraid/README.md for installation and safe adoption of existing containers.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Host TCP port mapped to container port 8000.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Required SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL URL using psycopg. Enter locally; see README for placeholder format and password encoding. Masking is not encryption.

Config.Name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: true for HTTPS; false only for trusted local HTTP testing. Secure cookies cannot authenticate over ordinary HTTP.
